PRIVATE SNAPSHOT KEY

Prepare the existing deployment

Use the existing owner-signed secret channel. The local process reads the deployment’s credentials, reuses its snapshot key if present, or creates one. Only the three snapshot variables are merged; existing secrets are preserved.

This protects S3 objects from readers without the key. The local process, relay secret store and running app can access the key. The current RISC deployment is not isolated from its host operator. No key value is shown in this page or included in public configuration.

Owner read → provision snapshot key → signed read-back → encrypt and verify legacy snapshots → review deployment update. No deployment update or activation is enabled by key provisioning alone.
